text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking down the
hallway...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ines! I knew I could count on you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Your Bakushin slides across the floor
applied the
wax so evenly... It was like
watching art in motion!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you're exaggerating for sure!
I'm just
used to this kind of work from
my cleaning job.
That's all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! However, as class representative,
etiquette
dictates that I must return the
favor! Please allow
me to show my
gratitude somehow!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Heh. Well, if you insist, then... I
want you to
come with me to a
supermarket sale!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But of course! I will gladly accompany
you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later on, during a stroll through the
school
grounds...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The probability of Ines being a cyborg
has
increased to forty-five percent.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! All I did was slice up a carrot.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. However, the thickness and
diameter
of the carrot slices are
numerically identical.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, so that's what you meant. Well, I
guess all
those food prep jobs must have
honed my
skills! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
So your precision is the result of
consistent
practice. Understood. Cyborg
probability has
fallen to zero percent.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Now I can eat a nutritious
meal that
reflects the data perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No prob! Call me anytime you need a
hand! Using
a food processor can be,
um, kinda tricky!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You suuure know how to do a thorough
cleat
check, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
My cleats are pretty unique, you know.
Even the
professionals have a hard time
with them.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
They're definitely an interesting pair...
but don't
you worry! I've dealt with a
huge range of
customers at one of my
regular gigs!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it sounds like all the staff at your
store
must be experts. Maybe I'll drop
by sometime!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ding, dong... ♪ This just in—I've got a
juicy tip
for any prospective customers!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If you purchase a pair of cleats today...
you'll be
eligible for a fifty percent
discount on a second
pair! Wow! Be sure
to take advantage of this
special
offer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haha, you really know how to upsell.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm just recognizing demand and
making sure
we supply it, that's all. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During a training session some time
later, I'm
talking with Ines Fujin about all
the good deeds I
saw her doing around
school today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Is that a compliment? C'mon, don't stop
with just
one!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Juuust kidding! Haha.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I'm doing this for my own
sake too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Helping others helps me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The person who gets helped is happy.
The person
who helps is happy. Smiles
all around!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's two birds with one stone! At that point, why would I not want to help people?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I know people worry about me
wearing
myself out, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm the type that thrives off of seeing
people
smile!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So that's why, if it means I can help
others out,
then I don't mind working my
butt off.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So that's why, if it means I can help
others out,
then I don't mind working my
butt off.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! You're right on the mark! I
feel like I
have gotten a stamina boost
recently!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wait, maybe I'm hitting three birds with one stone?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Talk about efficiency! I suddenly feel
super
motivated! There's no stopping me
now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now more motivated than ever, Ines
Fujin vows to
remain a do-gooder.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right! So, the other day, I
helped the
student council with their
paperwork!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It just kind of happened, you know? But
anyway,
we got to talking over our
coffee break, and the
council members
had so much insight to offer
about
racing!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Being able to casually show my face here
and
there is just another perk of helping
out! ♪
